Text: Real GST and ITR sessions in Firefox: the HUD/SGT sees the portal (URL read) and captures the same fields as the same pages in Chrome

Admin PC: Manage Services, add a service with a non-GST/ITR login link (e.g. EPF), confirm the domain prompt, open that portal in Chrome and check SGT/VSDC now reads it; delete the service and check capture stops there; also edit a link to a shared sign-in site listed in never_register and check the 'not registered' message
